content: writeJsonLine() calls that emit structured JSON results for *expected* failures (e.g. skipped[]/agent_not_found in register-agent.ts) should target context.stdio.stdout, not stderr. The non-zero exitCode already signals failure to scripts/CI; stderr is reserved for truly unexpected errors (formatError(err) catch blocks) and human-readable usage messages. Fixed in warren-524c / GH #533.

name: seeds-cli shared util module
description: src/seeds-cli/util.ts centralizes DEFAULT_SD_TIMEOUT_MS + truncate() shared by extensions.ts/list.ts/show.ts (warren-56a0); new sd-shellout helpers should import from there instead of re-copying the constant/helper.
src/cli/main.ts rebuilt PLAN_RUN_STATES as a local ReadonlySet after warren-b229 hoisted the canonical tuple
resolution: parsePlanRunState now imports PLAN_RUN_STATES from src/core/wire.ts and tests membership against it. Never reconstruct a Set at a call site from a canonical tuple — check:wire-types (warren-d371) now fails the build on this. This was a real pre-existing violation the new gate caught on a clean tree.
